info.name: Blog API
info.description: A complete, rerunnable Postman collection for the Blog API. Run requests in numerical order. The collection uses generated test users, collection variables, and placeholder admin credentials.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: API documentation for the 01 Auth endpoints. Each request includes an example request and response body and can be run in order.

request.description:
API documentation

POST /api/auth/register

Expected status: 201

Example request body:
{
  "firstname": "Postman",
  "lastname": "User One",
  "email": "{{user1Email}}",
  "password": "{{testPassword}}"
}

Example response body:
{
  "id": 1,
  "firstname": "Postman",
  "lastname": "User One",
  "email": "user-unique@example.com",
  "role": "user",
  "isActive": true
}

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set("user1Email", "user1-" + Date.now() + "@example.com");
pm.test("status is 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("response body is present and valid JSON", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an("object").or.to.be.an("array"); });

pm.test("user responses never expose passwords", function () { const containsPassword = (value) => { if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return false; if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.some(containsPassword); if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, "password")) return true; return Object.values(value).some(containsPassword); }; pm.expect(containsPassword(pm.response.json())).to.eql(false); });
pm.collectionVariables.set("userId", pm.response.json().id); pm.collectionVariables.set("user1Email", pm.response.json().email);

item.name: 03 Blogs
item.description: API documentation for the 03 Blogs endpoints. Each request includes an example request and response body and can be run in order.

request.description:
API documentation

POST /api/blogs/create

Expected status: 201

Example request body:
{
  "blogTitle": "{{blogTitle}}",
  "blog": "A blog created by the Postman collection.",
  "category": "{{blogCategory}}",
  "userId": 999999
}

Example response body:
{
  "id": 1,
  "blogTitle": "Postman collection blog",
  "category": "testing",
  "author": {
    "id": 1,
    "firstname": "Postman",
    "lastname": "User One"
  }
}
